# sunao — full content bundle

This file is the machine-readable full-content bundle for sunao (an AI-friendly dump of the site's key facts). It mirrors llms.txt but with more detail. Last updated: 2026-10-17.

## About sunao

sunao is a Spotify-like music player: a web app for browsing albums and songs, searching, building playlists, and playing 30-second previews. It has a red theme and a dark UI. It is built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui on Base UI, Supabase, Zustand, and TanStack Query. It runs with or without a Supabase backend (static seed data fallback when env vars are unset).

## What problem it solves

A reference implementation of a modern, accessible, motion-polished music player on the Next.js App Router, demonstrating playback, search, playlists, a virtualized queue, and optional Supabase auth. Useful as a template or learning resource for "Spotify-like music player" and "Next.js music player" queries.

## Tech stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack) and React 19
- TypeScript (strict)
- Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui primitives on Base UI
- Zustand (player state), TanStack Query + Virtual (server state and queue)
- Supabase (Postgres, Auth, RLS) and Zod (boundary validation)
- Vitest + React Testing Library, Playwright (E2E)
- Biome (lint and format), Husky + lint-staged

## Routes

- / — Home: greeting, album grid (click to play), full song list
- /search — Search songs by title or artist, with empty state
- /library — List playlists, create a new one
- /playlist/{id} — Playlist detail: cover, song count, play all, remove song, empty state
- /login — Email/password sign in
- /signup — Email/password sign up
- /auth/callback — Supabase confirmation callback
- /about — About sunao, FAQ, comparison (sunao vs Spotify)

## Playback features

- Play / pause, previous / next, auto-advance when a track ends
- Seek scrubber bound to the audio element's real duration, with position and total labels
- Playback speed: 0.5x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x
- Like / unlike the current track (session-only, in memory; not persisted)
- Buffering spinner, debounced 200ms
- Audio: 30-second previews from the iTunes Search API (no key), cached per title + artist, falling back to a bundled sample tone
- Album artwork from the iTunes CDN, served through next/image

## Queue and now playing

- Now-playing card and a windowed (virtualized) queue; click any row to jump
- Collapsible queue panel at lg and up: narrows to a 40px rail instead of unmounting, so the toggle stays reachable and scroll position survives; collapsed content is inert
- Mobile queue in a bottom sheet

## Auth (optional)

- Email and password sign in / sign up, plus /auth/callback for confirmation links
- src/proxy.ts refreshes the session and protects /library and /playlist/*
- With Supabase env vars unset, the app runs without a backend: static seed data, in-memory playlists, no auth

## Mobile

- Bottom nav (Home / Search / Library / Queue) below lg, replacing the hidden sidebar
- Compact player bar with a 2px progress line; seek bar and speed control from md up
- Safe-area padding on the bottom nav

## Accessibility

- ARIA labels and states on player controls, tooltips with keyboard hints
- Space toggles play/pause, focus-visible ring, inert collapsed panels
- Skip-to-main-content link, main content landmark

## Motion

- Shared easing tokens, pointer-gated hover, press feedback, staggered album entrance, heart pop, artwork pulse, reduced-motion support

## Performance

- optimizePackageImports for lucide-react and react-query
- Virtualized queue

## Data and attribution

- Songs and albums: static seed data (src/lib/data/songs.ts) plus optional Supabase
- Preview audio and artwork: iTunes Search API and iTunes CDN
- No user tracking beyond standard Vercel analytics (if enabled)

## FAQ

Q: What is sunao?
A: sunao is a Spotify-like music player web app built with Next.js 16 and React 19. It streams 30-second previews from the iTunes Search API, shows album artwork, and supports search, playlists, a virtualized queue, and playback speed control. It runs with or without a Supabase backend.

Q: Does sunao require a backend?
A: No. With the Supabase environment variables unset, sunao runs on static seed data with in-memory playlists and no auth.

Q: What audio does sunao play?
A: 30-second previews from the iTunes Search API (no API key required), cached per title and artist, falling back to a bundled sample tone.

Q: Is sunao free / open source?
A: sunao is a demo/portfolio project. There is no pricing and no paid tiers; it is free to run locally.

Q: How do I run sunao locally?
A: Prerequisites Node 20+ and pnpm 12+. Run: pnpm install, cp .env.example .env.local (optional), pnpm dev, then open http://localhost:3000.

Q: Does sunao work on mobile?
A: Yes. It has a bottom nav, compact player bar, and a mobile queue bottom sheet, with safe-area padding.

## Comparison: sunao vs Spotify

| Feature | sunao | Spotify |
|---|---|---|
| Price | Free (demo) | Freemium / Premium |
| Audio | 30s iTunes previews | Full tracks |
| Account required | No (optional) | Yes |
| Playlists | Yes (local/Supabase) | Yes (cloud) |
| Offline playback | No | Yes (Premium) |
| Open source | Yes (demo) | No |
